clauses.text: Collision coverage under POL-OTHER-0001 pays for front-end and rear-end collision damage to the insured vehicle after the applicable deductible is met.
This other-policy collision clause states that bumper and body-panel repairs from a collision event are covered only when reported within 30 days.
POL-OTHER-0001 excludes racing, track use, and any collision occurring while the vehicle is used as a public or livery conveyance.
Claims under POL-OTHER-0001 must be filed through the other-carrier portal and include a police report for any collision over $2,000.
